name: STA302H1 — Deductive Derivation (Multiple Regression and Diagnostics)
description: Y=Xβ+ε. β̂=(XᵀX)⁻¹XᵀY. Gauss-Markov: OLS is BLUE. Var(β̂)=σ²(XᵀX)⁻¹. Each β̂ⱼ = PARTIAL effect of Xⱼ on Y, holding others constant.

steps.template_en: Y=Xβ+ε. β̂=(XᵀX)⁻¹XᵀY. Gauss-Markov: OLS is BLUE. Var(β̂)=σ²(XᵀX)⁻¹. Each β̂ⱼ = PARTIAL effect of Xⱼ on Y, holding others constant.
Residual diagnostics: (1) Constant variance: residuals vs fitted. (2) Normality: Q-Q. (3) Independence: Durbin-Watson. (4) Linearity: partial residual plots.
steps.template_zh: 残差诊断：(1)同方差：残差vs拟合。(2)正态性：Q-Q。(3)独立性：Durbin-Watson。(4)线性：偏残差图。

steps.template_en: Influential points: (1) LEVERAGE hᵢᵢ from hat matrix H. (2) OUTLIER: |studentized residual|>3. (3) INFLUENTIAL: Cook's D>4/n. High leverage + outlier = dangerous!
steps.template_zh: 影响点：(1)杠杆值hᵢᵢ。(2)异常值：|学生化残差|>3。(3)影响点：Cook D>4/n。高杠杆+异常值=危险！

steps.template_en: Multicollinearity: VIFⱼ=1/(1-R²_{Xⱼ|others}). VIF>10 → serious. Effects: inflated SEs, unstable estimates. Solutions: (1) Remove. (2) Ridge. (3) PCA.
steps.template_zh: 共线性：VIF>10→严重。影响：SE膨胀、估计不稳定。解决：(1)移除。(2)岭回归。(3)主成分。

steps.template_en: Variable selection: (1) Stepwise — fast but overfits. (2) All subsets — expensive. (3) AIC/BIC: lower better. (4) LASSO — L1 regularization, automatic selection.
steps.template_zh: 变量选择：(1)逐步——快速但过拟合。(2)全子集——昂贵。(3)AIC/BIC：越低越好。(4)LASSO——自动选择。

steps.template_en: Multiple regression = 'Swiss Army Knife.' Used in: economics (hedonic pricing), epidemiology (adjusting confounders), ML (linear basis expansion). Diagnostics are ESSENTIAL for valid inference.
steps.template_zh: 多元回归='瑞士军刀'。用于经济学、流行病学、机器学习。诊断是有效推断的必要条件。
